name: Augmented Radiance Field
aliases: Augmented Radiance Field / Error-Driven Gaussian Supplementation
definition: A post-enhancement framework that augments existing 3DGS scenes by adding Gaussian kernels with view-dependent opacity to explicitly model specular components, compensating for the inability of spherical harmonics to decouple diffuse and specular radiance.
summary: Augmented Radiance Field enhances 3D Gaussian Splatting by adding view-dependent opacity primitives to explicitly model specular highlights, avoiding spherical harmonics limitations.
